title: Core logic and game loop
prompt: Write the JavaScript game loop for a Snake game in ONE self-contained HTML file. Draw to <canvas id="gameCanvas">. Define the snake as an array of {x,y} objects and food as {x,y}. Implement logic for the snake moving automatically on page load (no start screen) without needing a key press. Implement collision detection against walls and self. Expose a main function named update() that handles logic and a function named draw() for rendering. The game should run in an infinite loop driven by setInterval.

title: Input handling and game states
prompt: Write the JavaScript keyboard handling for a Snake game in ONE self-contained HTML file. Use document.addEventListener('keydown', ...) to handle arrow keys for controlling the snake's direction. Implement a restart mechanism: when the 'Restart' button inside <div id="gameOverOverlay"> is clicked, call the update() function and reset the game state. Ensure the <div id="gameOverOverlay"> is visible only after a collision occurs and hidden again by the restart button. Ensure the text 'GAME OVER' is only visible when the game is over.

title: Food generation and rendering
prompt: Write the JavaScript logic to generate and render food in ONE self-contained HTML file. Place food randomly on the grid. Ensure food does not spawn on top of the snake. Update the <div id="score"> element when food is eaten. This logic should be integrated into the update() function to draw to <canvas id="gameCanvas">.
